import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0018 (a b c : ℝ) (h_a_pos : a > 0) (h_discr_neg : b^2 - 4 * a * c < 0) : ∀ x : ℝ, a * x^2 + b * x + c > 0 := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0018 (a b c : ℝ) (h_a_pos : a > 0) (h_discr_neg : b^2 - 4 * a * c < 0) : ∀ x : ℝ, a * x^2 + b * x + c > 0 := by
  intro x
  have h1 : a * x^2 + b * x + c = a * (x + b / (2 * a))^2 + c - b^2 / (4 * a) := (by rw [mul_add, add_assoc, mul_div_cancel_left (ne_of_gt h_a_pos)])
  have h2 : a * (x + b / (2 * a))^2 ≥ 0 := (by (apply mul_nonneg (h_a_pos) (sq_nonneg (x + b / (2 * a))))
  have h3 : c - b^2 / (4 * a) > 0 := (by (linarith (h_discr_neg (x + b / (2 * a)) (h_a_pos (x + b / (2 * a)))) (x + b / (2 * a) > -b / (2 * a) (h_a_pos (x + b / (2 * a)))))
  exact (add_pos (h2) (h3))
END FORMAT EXAMPLE.
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0018 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0018 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0018

run_cmd do
  let expectedInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0018
  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0018
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"
